benchmark.selection: First 16 COCO published training rows, without rejection or model-based selection, plus eight fixed Commons gap checks. None are the previous six photographs. Alternating source order assigns audit/held-out. Both libraries and judgments frozen before inference; no tuning after the audit split.
benchmark.judgmentPolicy: Visible main subject or setting must fit the supplied description, including explicit qualifiers. Accepted IDs recorded before model outputs, separately from scores. Empty lists mark no adequate candidate. One evaluator; these are qualitative relevance judgments, not independently adjudicated ground truth or population accuracy.

acceptance.notes: Product gates fixed before inference, not calibrated model-score thresholds. Leading four are the best plus the three alternatives actually displayed. No universal cosine cutoff. Explicit opt-in/download disclosure, privacy, fallback and resource error handling are mandatory; physical mobile unsupported until tested.
